Whereas for over 25 years, the National Coalition for the Homeless and National Student Campaign Against Hunger and Homelessness have sponsored National Hunger and Homelessness Awareness Week. And whereas the purpose of the proclamation is to educate the public about the many reasons people experience hunger and homelessness and to encourage

support for homeless assistance service providers, as well as community service opportunities for students and school service organizations. And whereas we continue to educate the public about the many contributing factors to pervasive hunger and homelessness in our own city and across the nation, acknowledging the importance of creating and preserving housing that residents can afford, as well as ensuring access to living wage jobs, reliable transportation, affordable child care, comprehensive health and mental health care, treatment for substance use disorders, and resources to overcome language barriers, and further recognizing the need to address the
